Data Analyst.description: Analyzes datasets, builds reports, and supports evidence-based business decisions.

Business Intelligence Analyst.description: Transforms organizational data into dashboards, metrics, and decision-ready insights.

Data Scientist.description: Uses statistical analysis and machine learning to answer complex questions with data.

Data Engineer.description: Builds reliable data pipelines and platforms that make data available for analysis.

Machine Learning Engineer.description: Develops, evaluates, and deploys machine-learning models in software systems.

AI Engineer.description: Integrates artificial-intelligence models and services into user-facing applications.

Database Administrator.description: Maintains database availability, performance, security, backup, and recovery.

Software Engineer.description: Designs, builds, tests, and maintains software applications and services.

Full-Stack Developer.description: Develops both browser-based interfaces and the server-side services behind them.

Mobile App Developer.description: Builds and maintains applications for mobile operating systems and devices.

QA Engineer.description: Plans and performs software tests to find defects and improve product quality.

DevOps Engineer.description: Automates software delivery and operates reliable development and production systems.

Cloud Engineer.description: Designs and operates secure, scalable infrastructure on cloud platforms.

Cybersecurity Analyst.description: Monitors systems, investigates threats, and helps reduce organizational security risks.

Cybersecurity Engineer.description: Designs and implements technical controls that protect systems and information.

Network Engineer.description: Designs, configures, and troubleshoots computer networks and connectivity.

IT Support Specialist.description: Resolves user and device issues and maintains reliable workplace technology.

UX/UI Designer.description: Researches user needs and designs usable, accessible digital product experiences.

Product Designer.description: Shapes digital products through user research, interaction design, and prototyping.

Business Analyst.description: Turns stakeholder needs into documented requirements and measurable process improvements.

Project Manager.description: Coordinates scope, people, timelines, risks, and delivery across projects.

Product Manager.description: Sets product direction and coordinates delivery around customer and business needs.

Digital Marketing Analyst.description: Measures digital campaign performance and turns audience data into marketing insights.

Digital Marketing Specialist.description: Plans and manages digital campaigns across search, social, email, and web channels.

HR Analyst.description: Uses workforce data to inform recruitment, retention, and people operations.

Operations Analyst.description: Analyzes business processes and performance to improve operational efficiency.

Technical Writer.description: Creates clear technical documentation, guides, and reference materials for users and teams.
